description_expanded: Pelican Paradise is a stunning Gulf front vacation home offering 10 bedrooms and 8.5 bathrooms; a true oasis on Scenic Highway 30A! This luxurious vacation property is the perfect choice for a large party or multi-family vacation, where both space and proximity to the beach are paramount. This Pelican Paradise listing consists of two properties, Pelican Paradise A and Pelican Paradise B. This listing allows you to book both properties together as an expansive, private oasis for an unparalleled vacation experience. Experience the luxury of Pelican Paradise A by Scenic Stays 30A, an unforgettable accommodation that you won't soon forget. Upon entering the Camp Creek Lake privately gated community, guests can spend an entire vacation without leaving the comfort of Pelican Paradise A. Guests are greeted with the well-manicured and kempt grounds of Pelican Paradise A. A private pool sits enclosed on the patio on the south side of the home, with the second-story balcony overlooking the pool. Entry at the ground level, the first of two living spaces greets you with a sofa sleeper, wet bar, wine cooler. When the family is not at the beach, the pool, or the delightful kitchen upstairs, this is the perfect space to relax and unwind. The ground level features three full bedrooms and two full bathrooms. The first bedroom features a Twin over Full bunk bed, to sleep 3. The second bedroom features two twin bunk beds, with the last bedroom featuring a King bed. 11 total guests can comfortably sleep on the first level of this amazing beach home. The second story of Pelican Paradise A features a kitchen that is a chef's delight. Fantastic appliances allow for a dynamic cooking and preparatory experience, where no meal is too large or small to take part in. Surrounded by a wraparound counter and bar stools, guests can enjoy time overlooking the kitchen or seated at the kitchen table. Newly upholstered sofas and chairs allow for seating in the second story while enjoying TV, or taking in the breathtaking views of the Gulf of Mexico and emerald waves splashing onto the beach from the luxury of the indoors. A half bathroom conveniently completes the common area of the second story. On the south side of the second story is the second Master Bedroom, with a King bed and Twin over Twin bunks. A full bathroom completes this exceptionally large, dynamic room. The best is saved for last, with the complete Master Bedroom and Bathroom on the third story. It cannot get any better than a full view of the Gulf of Mexico, a private balcony with seating, and an extensive master bathroom all to yourself. Wake up to the waves crashing right outside your window, enjoy the jetted garden tub, and delight in the extensive space and luxury of this delightful master bedroom. Featuring a King-sized bed, you will want nothing more than all this home has to offer. A propane grill and ample outdoor seating are on the balcony leading to the beach boardwalk. Guests can also enjoy complimentary beach gear! Pelican Paradise B Experience the luxury of Pelican Paradise B by Scenic Stays 30A, an unforgettable accommodation that you won't soon forget. Upon entering the Camp Creek Lake privately gated community, guests can spend an entire vacation without leaving the comfort of Pelican Paradise B. Guests are greeted with the well-manicured and kept grounds of Pelican Paradise B. A private pool sits enclosed on the patio on the south side of the home, with the second-story balcony overlooking the pool. Entry at the ground level, the first of two living spaces greets you with a sofa sleeper, wet bar, wine cooler. When the family is not at the beach, the pool, or the delightful kitchen upstairs, this is the perfect space to relax and unwind. The ground level features three full bedrooms and two full bathrooms. The first bedroom features a Twin over Full bunk bed, to sleep 3. The second bedroom features two twin bunk beds, with the last bedroom featuring a King bed. 11 total guests can comfortably sleep on the first level of this amazing beach home. The second story of Pelican Paradise B features a kitchen that is a chef's delight. Fantastic appliances allow for a dynamic cooking and preparatory experience, where no meal is too large or small to take part in. Surrounded by a wraparound counter and bar. Guests must be above the age of 25, or must be accompanied by an adult chaperone throughout their stay. Pets are not welcome to accompany their families at this home, events are not allowed and it is a strictly non smoking property.
